limitedSupport: Lo mboneleli unokungaxhaswa ngokupheleleyo. Izakhono (izixhobo, umbono, iaudio) ayibonwa ngokuzenzekelayo - yongeza iimodeli ngesandla kwaye uqwalasele ubunakho ngemodeli nganye.
mlxExperimental: MLX inkxaso iyalingwa. Uzinziso alufumaneki, ingqiqo yokuguqula ayikadityaniswa, kwaye ezinye iimodeli ezintsha zoyilo ezinokusilela ukulayisha. Xela imiba kwi-GitHub ukuze sibeke phambili.
engineBundled: Injini ye-inference yakhelwe kwi-Novera, ngoko akukho nto yokukhuphela okanye ukuhlaziya ngokwahlukileyo. Caphula olu guqulelo xa unika ingxelo ngomzekelo osilela ukulayisha.
engineOtherVersion: Ngaba ufuna inguqulo ye-llama.cpp eyahlukileyo? Sebenzisa i-llama-server yakho kwaye uyongeze njengomboneleli ohambelana ne-OpenAI.
refreshModelsError: UMboneleli kufuneka abe nesiseko URL kunye ubuncinane neqhosha elinye le-API elilungiselelwe ukulanda imifuziselo.
refreshModelsSuccess: Yongezwe i-{{count}} imodeli entsha esuka ku-{{provider}}.
noNewModels: Akukho mifuziselo mitsha ifunyenweyo. Zonke iimodeli ezikhoyo sele zongeziwe.
refreshModelsFailed: Ayiphumelelanga ukulanda iimodeli kwi-{{provider}}. Nceda ujonge isitshixo sakho se-API kunye nesiseko se-URL.
embeddingModelsDesc: Isetyenziselwa i-RAG kunye nokukhangela i-vector. Imodeli ekhethiweyo iba yeyokuqala xa usenza uzingiso.
importedTooltip: Ithathwe ngaphandle kwifayile yendawo. Ukuyisusa kwi-Novera akuyi kuyicima ifayile kwidiski.
noModelFoundDesc: Iimodeli ezikhoyo ziya kudweliswa apha. Ukuba awukabinazo iimodeli okwangoku, ndwendwela i-Hub ukuze ukhuphele.
noModelFoundRemoteDesc: Iimodeli ezikhoyo ziya kudweliswa apha. Sebenzisa iqhosha lokuhlaziya elingasentla ukulanda imifuziselo kumboneleli, okanye wongeze enye ngesandla ngeqhosha +.

deleteModel.importedDescription: Susa le modeli ingeniswe ngaphandle kwi-Novera? Ifayile yakho yobulali kwidiski ayisayi kucinywa.

deleteAllModels.title: Cima zonke iimodeli ezikhutshelweyo?
deleteAllModels.description: Oku kuya kuyisusa ngokusisigxina imodeli (ii) {{count}} kwidiski.
deleteAllModels.importedExcluded: {{count}} imodeli/iimodeli ezisuka kwamanye amazwe ziya kugcinwa (iifayile zazo azikhutshelwanga yi-Novera).
deleteAllModels.partialFailure: Ayiphumelelanga ukucima imodeli(ii) {{count}}. Jonga i-console ngeenkcukacha.

deleteProvider.description: Cima lo mboneleli kunye nazo zonke iimodeli zakhe. Esi senzo asinakuphinda singenziwa.
deleteProvider.confirmDescription: Ngaba uqinisekile ukuba ufuna ukucima lo mboneleli? Esi senzo asinakuphinda singenziwa.

editModel.title: Hlela iModeli: {{modelId}}
editModel.description: Qwalasela imodeli yesakhono ngokutshintshela kwiinketho ezingezantsi.

warning.title: Qhubeka ngokuqaphela
warning.description: Ukulungiswa kwezakhono zemodeli kunokuchaphazela ukusebenza kunye nokusebenza. Useto olungachanekanga lunokubangela ukuziphatha okungalindelekanga okanye iimpazamo.

baseUrl.title: Isiseko URL
baseUrl.azureDescription: Isiphelo sakho se-Azure OpenAI. Faka endaweni ye-YOUR-RESOURCE-NAME ngegama lakho lesixhobo se-Azure.
baseUrl.alibabaDescription: Sebenzisa isiphelo sendawo yakho yokusebenza yeAlibaba Cloud kunye nommandla. Faka esikhundleni i-YOUR-WORKSPACE-ID ngendawo yakho yokusebenza ID kwaye usebenzise iqhosha le-API elisuka kwindawo efanayo.

apiKeys.title: API izitshixo
apiKeys.description: Faka isitshixo sakho API. Unokongeza izitshixo ezongezelelweyo kwi-Advanced, kwaye Novera iya kuzama elilandelayo ngokuzenzekelayo ukuba isitshixo asiphumelelanga.
apiKeys.testHint: Ijonga i-/models ngesitshixo ngasinye kwaye ibonise ubume beqhosha ngalinye.
apiKeys.oneKeyHint: Izitshixo ezizikhethelayo zokubuyela umva ziqwalaselwe kwi-Advanced.
